comments.note: DiffDialogTexts.cs is clean and follows every established project convention precisely: singleton localization access via _localization field, expression-body read-only properties, OnCultureChanged() registration, and the RefreshAll() legacy-compat method. The 28 new properties are grouped by logical section with descriptive comment headers, which is a quality-of-life improvement over the existing pre-WP-002 groupings that lacked some header labels. No action needed.

The five ConfirmRiskyDetail_* and ConfirmUpdateMessage_RiskyChanges property names use underscore separators within PascalCase identifiers (e.g., ConfirmRiskyDetail_Removals vs. ConfirmRiskyDetail_RemovalsPlural would be fully PascalCase). This is a deliberate mirror of the locale key names from WP-001, making grep-ability between .cs and JSON trivial. The Developer noted this in the implementation pipeline. It is a low-priority style inconsistency — the underscore convention is not wrong, but future new keys should prefer fully PascalCase identifiers (e.g., ConfirmRiskyDetailRemovals) when locale keys can be chosen freely. No action needed for this WP.

The OnCultureChanged() method now has 76 individual OnPropertyChanged() calls. This is a pre-existing structural pattern, not introduced by WP-002. As the class continues to grow, a CommunityToolkit.Mvvm [ObservableProperty] source-generator migration or a reflection-based bulk raise (OnPropertyChanged(string.Empty)) could eliminate the boilerplate entirely. The OnPropertyChanged(string.Empty) variant is the simplest zero-dependency option — it raises a change notification for all properties in one call, which is semantically correct for a bulk culture refresh. This is a future architectural consideration, not a blocking concern.

[documentation-forward] DiffDialogTexts.cs class-level XML summary doc ('Text ViewModel for DiffDialog.') is minimal and does not explain the OnCultureChanged() subscription model, the RefreshAll() legacy-compat method purpose, or that all new properties follow the locale-key-to-property-name 1:1 mapping convention. The Documentation agent should expand the class-level <summary> and add a <remarks> block covering these three aspects, consistent with how other ViewTexts classes are documented.

DiffBrushes.xaml is well-structured: the 5 new Guidance* brushes are placed under a matching '<!-- Sidebar guidance card backgrounds -->' comment block, visually separating them from the existing change-type and banner brushes. The alpha-channel color values (#33 = 20% alpha) provide visual coherence with the existing diff row brushes (#1A = ~10% alpha) at a slightly higher opacity appropriate for card backgrounds. No issues.
